history: Phase 11: same institution (Bihar Police), opposite readings. Arrest reports stay routine crime; institutional funding reads governance. Relevance passes both (tiers are not relevance).

cases.title: Bihar Police arrests murder accused
cases.body: Police on Monday arrested the accused in a murder case. The weapon was recovered, officials said.

cases.title: Bihar Police receives modernisation funding
cases.body: The state government has approved a Rs 750 crore modernisation programme for the police. Cyber laboratories will come up in all ranges.
